scope: The May 2013 main building of Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou. Includes the octagonal hall, blue roof tiers, four attached porch ranges, and main steps. The detached park gate, galleries, statue, and grounds are outside this building asset.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Guangzhou’s place-name heritage register identifies the main hall as a 49-meter octagonal structure with four attached double-eaved ranges and blue glazed roof tiles.
The municipal park authority names Lu Yanzhi and the 1931 completion, and records the main hall at 48.63 meters high, 72.65 meters north to south, and 63.32 meters east to west.
The public cultural heritage entry identifies the octagonal hall and its raised granite platform.

terrainFitEvidence.notes: The source surface rises over the roof region and varies substantially across the footprint. The south approach and primary photographic landing provide an independent model datum. Preserve these elevation samples and distinguish the original surface from any building-specific placement treatment in review.

sectionBasis: Use the municipal park authority’s 48.63-meter height as the massing control, with the cleared south entrance photo for the visible granite base, window and eave proportions. Registration to the variable original city surface requires a separate placement review.

mappedRoofAndPorticoControls.notes: The mapped octagonal crown, glazed drum and eight portico column centers set the horizontal section. The municipal architectural height sets the vertical control.
